notes.title: A Developer Nightmare Rework - Devlog 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177424/25687febd564a322dd7eb89f0b276f891612f8db.png[/img]

[h1]Hello[/h1]
I'm happy to announce a new rework coming to A Developer Nightmare!
As you may know, this game is made by just one guy… and that’s me.

I have some good and baddish news to share. So, let’s get into it!

[h1]Good News[/h1]
Let’s start with the exciting part—the game rework!

The game is shifting to a 2D style, which might sound like a crazy move, but I truly believe this change will allow me to create more content while maintaining high quality. This update also comes with a complete engine switch to Unity to improve development efficiency.

[h2]Key Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moving from 3D to 2D
[*] Game rework with a new engine (Unity)
[/list]

[h1]Baddish News[/h1]
Now, onto the "not-so-great" part.

As usual, I overthought the project and made it [b]multiplayer from the start[/b]—which, in hindsight, was not necessary. So, I have to make the tough call:

🚨 [b]Multiplayer will NOT be included at launch.[/b] 🚨

That said, multiplayer is still in my plans and something I want to add down the line!

Fun Fact:
I’ve remade this game three times now... in three different engines (Godot Engine, Unreal Engine, Unity).
[strike]Why do I do this to myself?[/strike]

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
[b]The game will be released[/b], but I can’t commit to a precise date yet—I want to make sure it’s [b]good [/b]before launching.

[h2]Stay tuned for more devlogs![/h2]
I’ll be sharing sneak peeks and more in-depth details soon.

Thanks for your patience and support!

Gregorio Antonio Curello – Developer
